channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Grant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Grant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Malone on Chris Grant
item.description:
Jason Lloyd:Sac's Mike Malone:

“I'm sure Chris Grant is smiling at home & deservedly so. His No. 1 guy came in & gets career high in points & rebounds”

Michael Malone on Chris Grant, Feb 12, 2014. Source: Twitter @JasonLloydABJ.

item.title: Mike Brown on Chris Grant, Dan Gilbert
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“They reached out to me at the end of last week for the first time and after getting over the initial shock of hearing from these guys again I spoke with my wife and thought about all the things that made this job attractive while I was here to begin with. The level of commitment from Dan Gilbert and his group, the thorough work ethic that Chris Grant and his staff display and you look at the roster with the young nucleus and then with Anderson (Varejao) and then the city and passion that the fans have for not only the Cavs but for all their sports teams, for us it was definitely an exciting thing that we were definitely interested in pressing forward with.”

Mike Brown on Chris Grant, Dan Gilbert, Apr 25, 2013. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Jeremy Pargo on Chris Grant
item.description:
“Our approach remains consistent as we try to bring in young talent, create future opportunity with draft picks as potential assets and maintain flexibility,'' Grant said in a press release.”

Jeremy Pargo on Chris Grant, Jul 25, 2012. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Byron Scott on Chris Grant
item.description:
On that topic, Cavaliers coach Byron Scott said Saturday that one key is not making the wrong move.

“The one thing I love about [General Manager Chris Grant] is, he's not trying to do something right now out of panic,”

Byron Scott on Chris Grant, Jan 2, 2011. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.
